I need to implement a JavaScript function that computes a running total of an array of non-negative numbers, capped at a given positive value. Once the cumulative sum reaches the cap, all subsequent positions in the output array should remain fixed at that cap.

The implementation uses a single loop with `Math.min(total + num, cap)` to keep the running sum capped. Once the total reaches the cap, every subsequent element is fixed at that value.
